payload.rationale: The obligation asks whether FY2025 enforceable effluent limitations and monitoring requirements are set forth in permit Parts with fact sheets and statements of basis serving only as supporting rationale rather than as independent effluent limits, for all three listed facilities. The farmington/final_permit.pdf cover excerpt grounds that effluent limitations and monitoring requirements are set forth in Part I through Part IV for that permit corpus, and farmington/statement_of_basis.pdf identifies permit NM0020583, partially aligning one facility with an operative-Parts source. However, the packet does not establish the rationale-versus-independent-limit distinction: the fact-sheet and statement-of-basis excerpts only identify those documents as pertaining to draft permits and do not show that they lack independent enforceable limits or that their role is exclusively supporting rationale. No final-permit Parts operative clause is provided for NM0028762 or NM0000116, and those permit numbers do not appear in the selected spans. The FY2025 window is stated in purposes/visible_a.md but is not tied to operative permit text for each facility. ACCEPT would require establishing the full operative-Parts versus rationale-only distinction across the obligation scope; REJECT would require establishing that limits are not operative in Parts or that fact sheets/SOB are independent limits—neither burden is met. Uncertainty is left open rather than closed by absence.
